title: TruckRNG
features:
Core Features
🚀 Dynamic Spawning System: Unlike standard scripts that spawn vehicles at a fixed location, this tool calculates your character's orientation and spawns the selected vehicle exactly 10 studs in front of you.

💰 Auto-Farming Suite: Includes dedicated Toggles for World, Cash, and Tix. Once activated, it sends high-frequency server requests (9,000 units per 0.5s) to boost your balance instantly.

🏎️ Complete Vehicle Database: Integrated buttons for every single collection:

Specials & Gamepasses: NyanTruck, RedCar, Motorcycles, and Scooters.

Regional Collections: Full sets for Asia (1-9) and Europe (1-29).

Seasonal & Group: Halloween, Christmas, RNG Group, and RNG 8 trucks.

Currency Trucks: Complete Tix (1-24) and World (1-18) collections.

⚡ Optimized Performance: Built with task.spawn threading to ensure the UI remains smooth while the auto-farm runs in the background.
